TruchiEmu

The ultimate retro gaming experience, beautifully reimagined for macOS

Get Started Explore Features

Why TruchiEmu?

A modern, native macOS emulator with pro-grade features and stunning visuals.

🎮

Universal System Support

Powered by libretro, TruchiEmu supports virtually every gaming system with an available core, from 8-bit classics to complex 3D consoles and arcade machines.

🎨

Beautiful Native Interface

100% native macOS SwiftUI with smooth animations, dark mode support, and a polished user experience that feels right at home on your Mac.

🔮

Pro-Grade Shaders

14 built-in Metal shaders including authentic CRT (Lottes, LiteCRT, Multipass), handheld LCD effects (GB, GBC, GBA, PSP, NDS, 3DS), and clean scaling filters.

🏆

RetroAchievements

Earn trophies and compete on leaderboards with full RetroAchievements integration, including hardcore mode for the ultimate challenge.

💾

Save State Management

Intuitive slot-based save states with automatic save management and migration tools for seamless upgrades.

🎮

Controller Support

Full gamepad support with per-system controller mapping, popular controller presets (Xbox, PlayStation, MFi, Arcade Stick), and customizable controls.

🖌️

Themes & Appearance

16 curated gaming-inspired accent color themes—from Samus to Doom—plus a custom color picker, light/dark appearance modes, and tinted surfaces.

🖱️

Analog Mouse Support

Use your gamepad's analog sticks to control the mouse cursor in DOS and ScummVM games — with configurable buttons for clicks and D-pad for keyboard inputs.

🥊

Training Mode & Move Lists

Automate player 2 with dummy control (stance, guard, wake-up tech), program frame-perfect sequences, and view on-screen move notations for competitive play.

🔔

Notification System

In-game notification pills for game actions, controller connections, and system events. Full notification history panel for review.
